scope.description: Whole qgis application/library breadth across useful functional families.
scope.denominator: Vector/raster data management, CRS, geometry processing, analysis, styling/maps, editing, databases and plugins.

coverage.rationale: Several connected vector analysis and table workflows are useful, but raster analysis, cartography, broad editing and plugin capabilities are missing.

scope.description: Bounded 2D vector reprojection/buffering/clipping, polygon centroids, typed selection and grouped attribute summaries.
scope.denominator: User intent and domain decisions within the named supported workflows, including declared inputs, composition and useful outputs; excluded application features do not enter this score.

abstraction.rationale: Metric geometry intent, typed selections, grouped quantities and explicit requirements remove many native steps; CRS and geometry choices still need expertise.

limitations: Bounded 2D GeoJSON/GeoPackage scope; annotation-only units, regenerated feature IDs and restricted aggregates; previews are not georeferenced rasters.

Editorial estimate from current contracts, guidance and completion evidence; no exhaustive native API denominator or new native acceptance was measured for this assessment. Qualification and runtime availability must be queried separately.
